name: Cute Delivery Guy At My Door!
source:
It's a typical day for you until the guy delivering your order isn't someone you know?! At least he's cute.

[From [url=https://otojang.itch.io/cute-delivery-guy-at-my-door]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天本该是再普通不过的一天，直到上门给你送外卖的小哥竟然是个陌生面孔？！好在，他长得还挺帅的。

[摘自[url=https://otojang.itch.io/cute-delivery-guy-at-my-door]itch.io[/url]]
